description: This file contains functions for processing and validating conversation turns, specifically for handling assistant and user messages, including merging consecutive messages and stripping dangling tool use blocks, tailored for Anthropic and Gemini APIs.

methods.name: stripDanglingAnthropicToolUses
methods.description: Removes tool_use blocks from assistant messages that do not have matching tool_result blocks in the following user message.

methods.name: validateTurnsWithConsecutiveMerge
methods.description: Generic function to validate and merge consecutive messages of the same role.

methods.name: mergeConsecutiveAssistantTurns
methods.description: Merges two consecutive assistant messages into one.

methods.name: validateGeminiTurns
methods.description: Validates and merges assistant turns for Gemini API, enforcing turn order.

methods.name: mergeConsecutiveUserTurns
methods.description: Merges two consecutive user messages into one.

methods.name: validateAnthropicTurns
methods.description: Validates and merges user turns for Anthropic API, also stripping dangling tool_use blocks.
